sections.heading: 3 business units
sections.text:
3 business units
Our services bring together the capabilities needed to plan, deliver and support technical facilities. The exact scope is tailored to each project and may include engineering, procurement, construction, process-critical utilities, total tool installation and energy facility management.
Unit 1
Design and build
EPC
Engineering, Procurement & Construction
Engineering, procurement and construction for a hi-tech facility, scoped to what each project needs. IAQ answers for the system working as intended.
Learn more about EPC
→
Unit 2
Tools in, fab live
PCU & TTI
Process Critical Utilities & Total Tool Installation Solutions
Process Critical Utilities builds the gas, chemical, water and exhaust systems. Total Tool Installation connects each tool to them, inside a fab that keeps running. Semiconductor only.
Learn more about PCU & TTI
→
Unit 3
Run and maintain
EFM
Energy Facility Management
IAQ helps organisations optimise energy infrastructure, improve reliability and create measurable long-term value across their facilities.
Learn more about EFM
→
